description.en: The AppName of the live stream.
The name of the live stream.

descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口删除App级别录制配置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Obtain the main streaming domain, then call this operation to delete a recording configuration at the AppName level.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-app-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveAppRecordConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --AppName liveApp0000
